entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I want to return this helmet I bought. This is absolutely ridiculous. I've been trying to figure it out on your website and it's impossible. I want my money back now.
I understand your frustration, and I can definitely help you with that return. To get started, could I have your order number, please?

It's VF88602. Look, I'm not happy. The color is completely different from what your website showed. It's a matter of safety! I need to be seen on the road, and this washed-out garbage isn't going to cut it. It's still in the box, the box is unopened, I haven't even touched the thing!
I see. Thank you for that order number. Let me just pull that up. Okay, I see the AeroFlow helmet, delivered on December 31st. I understand your concern about the color and its importance for safety.

So are you going to process the return or not? Don't waste my time reading me my own order. Get me your manager if you can't do this simple thing. I swear I will write a review that will sink your company.

There's no need for that, sir. I can handle this for you right now. I've just checked our policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for the helmet. I am processing the full refund for you as we speak.
Wait, really? Just like that? 10 days?

Yes, absolutely. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... fine. I'll look for the email.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
